results.title: Animal trafficking on the AP-7: up to 2,000 euros for a puppy
results.description: A refrigerated van was circulating on the AP-7, at the height of Girona. The Mossos decided to stop it and, inside, they found 14 puppies of various breeds, such as cavapoo, cavalier, maltipoo or teckel. Where did the dogs come from? From Slovakia. And where were they going? To a zoo in Empordà that, surprisingly, no longer exists. Furthermore, the puppies were about 10 weeks old — below the minimum legal age permitted for import, set at 15 weeks — and also did not meet the sanitary requirements. The animals were transferred to a shelter and the driver ended up arrested.
